substantive_delta: The frozen proof supplies the previously missing full nonrecognizability proof for the exact position-sum witness, using a minimum-active-output retraction for arbitrary singular copyless polynomial maps. Its pullback is a polynomial spectral projection, acts identically on the invertible minimal observable quotient, and simultaneously compresses every letter to affine coordinate permutations. A Jordan-factor argument forces unipotent minimal letters to commute, and return words of different densities extend the contradiction to arbitrary finite control. Together with the attributed uniform pumping formula this completely disproves the original sufficiency implication over Q.
why_nonroutine: Squarefree linearization, weighted minimization, Jordan decomposition and the pumping formula are standard or explicitly prior work; they alone do not justify compression through a singular physical representation. The projection and common invariant-subquotient argument establish precisely that missing bridge. Existing block-triangular monomial-cover criteria still permit the noncommuting UT_3 witness, and the inspected semiring-specific growth results do not control rational cancellation. The proof thus adds a substantive structural obstruction rather than an elementary corollary, rediscovery of the pumping formula, or bounded-register toy separation. No equivalent resolution was found in the recorded current primary-source screen.
significance: The result resolves the explicit STACS 2026 question in its original full model and shows why uniform one-word pumping families cannot characterize copyless polynomial streaming computation. The new simultaneous observable-quotient obstruction applies without a register bound or invertible physical updates, providing a reusable expressiveness tool. This is a substantive theoretical contribution; the assessment is local mathematical review, not a claim of global priority or venue acceptance.
